scope: Every presented separable quintic/sextic model over an algebraically closed field of odd characteristic; no geometric classification converse.
main_reused_theorems: Mathlib polynomial reflection, separability, finite-dimensional linear equivalences
Retained project all-place regularity from two separable charts, quadratic function-field construction, Riemann-Hurwitz genus theorem, and actual Cartier coefficient formula
Retained project canonical generic-restriction equivalence between scheme-global and regular forms
Retained project Picard logarithm, Cartier-fixed torsion identification, actual Jacobian construction and arbitrary representing Jacobian point-group equivalence
proof_adaptation: Generalizes the project IKO/RegularBasis.lean and IKO/GlobalForms.lean interfaces from the two explicit families to any separable polynomial of degree five or six; proves the previously missing reciprocal-chart separability and regularity.
mathematical_reference: IKO (1986), Section 1.1 equations (1.1)-(1.5), and characteristic-three case associated with Proposition 1.13. The presentation of every abstract genus-two curve by a hyperelliptic equation and the geometric supersingular/superspecial equivalences are not proved.
